description.value:
Traits Paradise-Touched

Your spells that deal force damage count as one rank higher whenever their rank determines what they can end, suppress, or counteract — most importantly, their counteract rank. Their damage, spell DC, save DC, and every other numeric element are unchanged, and this does not let you cast them at a higher rank.

cinderfall.incomplete: Your force spells count one rank higher for ending/suppressing/counteract purposes only. No `counteract-rank` property exists on `ItemAlteration`, and no rule-element key for a counteract-rank override without an actual rank change exists anywhere in `pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/` -- searched and confirmed absent.
